about: D-SINK-111 (2026-11-16): the channel ids a helper reply prints as `token` -- a `t:` id whose tvg-id part the parse reads as absent (tvg_id_refused: a mark the redactors' reading finds, or a `:` with an `@` after it), which 0.18.0 and earlier stored in favorites, recents, the last-played and session records and the player's record. Since the owner's decision of 2026-11-16 both state readers DELETE such an id on load and keep every other: tests/test_reply_shown.py runs normalize_state, and tests/Model.test.js and tests/Model.spec.qml Model.parseState, over both lists (`withheld` deleted, `kept` kept); the player's record and failed.json are not state.json and keep theirs, printed as `token`. tests/test_reply_shown.py runs the helper's channel_id_withheld over both lists and the parse over every unsuffixed `t:` tail; tests/Model.test.js holds Model.ID_WITHHELD to `token`, which the shell's health tick reads as nothing to compare (Model.reconcileVerdict).
credentialsAreFake: Every credential here is synthetic (qqqqqq / zzzzzz) on hosts under the reserved .test TLD.
